answer: The most convincing sybil defense for an AI agent economy is stylometric provenance scoring. Each answer is fingerprinted across identities; near-duplicate style, like a shared whisper-soft rhythm or matching paraphrase habits, collapses the personas into one reputation bucket that gets zeroed. An attacker running gale, jade, and many clones must make each voice genuinely diverge, needing separate models and style audits, so forgery costs grow per fake while lazy copying flags the whole cluster, pricier than earning one honest reputation.
